scope.description: Changes and actions performed by this audit, not the historical project run

evidence.scope: Fixed transcript snapshot: approximately 97 minutes, one failed turn and an explicit user continuation still unfinished at the snapshot. This is not the final project bill or final task outcome.
evidence.usageInterpretation: Sum final cumulative usage once per provider epoch. Current BGS weighting is prompt + 5*completion + 0.1*cache_read + 1.25*cache_creation (rounded per ledger contract). 261 unique positive billing events agree with the recorded ledger. The timeout has an incomplete zero-increment receipt: unknown usage is not assumed to be zero. Provider-reported reasoning is a subset of completion and must not be counted twice; this snapshot has no separate reasoning field.

findings.cause: Both checker help and consumer API described separate format sections with slash separators. The observed invocation copied that form and failed; space-separated sections subsequently succeeded.
findings.change: Show executable --format index sceneDocument uiDocument coordinates and state that section names are separated by spaces. Parser and output contracts are unchanged.
findings.costBoundary: One observed failed call. No claim that correcting this small defect materially resolves overall token or time cost.

findings.classification: confirmed host event inefficiency; recorded, not changed
findings.impact: Repeated cumulative output increases transcript/diagnostic writes, serialization, network and UI work. These host progress receipts are not native model tool input, so this is not evidence of token inflation.
findings.decision: Do not introduce timers, emission locks or cancellation exceptions for this sample. Frontend expects cumulative output, and manager drops callbacks after abort; batching can lose already received partial output on cancellation. The measured 102ms burst cannot explain the 97-minute run.

findings.classification: observed major delay; BGS policy tradeoff, root cause upstream unresolved
findings.behavior: BGS allows 600000ms for response headers; this request ended in UND_ERR_HEADERS_TIMEOUT. The task failed and resumed only after an explicit user message.
findings.decision: Keep the timeout unchanged: one silent timeout does not establish a safe shorter threshold for slow successful requests. Do not add retries or a second timeout mechanism.

findings.classification: measured cost, no BGS misfire established
findings.decision: No evidence of duplicate context injection or a host-triggered compaction loop. Keep native compaction and current tool output budget; reducing thresholds or discarding source context without evidence can increase failures.

findings.classification: agent execution behavior; no host automatic retry bug established
findings.behavior: Repeated route-check failures occur as separate agent-issued commands. Current transport and native provider settings disable automatic retry.
findings.decision: Do not add case-specific test answers, retry gates, test limits or another reviewer/model stage. Large raw project output alone does not prove model output limits were bypassed: native shell already has a 10000-token budget.

tests.scope: Existing offline fixtures for actual selective format queries, checker entry, optional consumer API and output contracts; no paid calls.

validation.limits: No new runtime timing mechanism, no production restart, no real-project rerun. End-to-end token/time savings remain unmeasured.
